chunks: They have appointed equals of God to mislead people from His path. Tell them: "Enjoy yourselves (so long as you may). In the end you have to go to Hell."

key_terms.أَنْدَادًا: Equals or counterparts (plural ofندّ), referring to false deities or partners assigned to Allah.
key_terms.تَمَتَّعُوا: Enjoy yourselves, a command to enjoy worldly life briefly as a form of divine decree for disbelievers.
key_terms.سَبِيلِهِ: His path, referring to the way of monotheism and divine guidance.
key_terms.مَصِيرَكُمْ: Your return/destination, referring to the final abode in the Hereafter.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Andad' in Surah Ibrahim and why did polytheists assign partners to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the strategic nature of shirk, where polytheists used idols not merely for worship but as tools to divert people from Tawhid. The command 'temattu'' (enjoy) is interpreted as a concession for their temporary pleasure, contrasting with the eternal punishment awaiting those who actively mislead others, a theme echoed in the dialogue between the idolaters and their deities in verse 22.
